prompt: Use the supplied Compound guidance. For each independent scenario, describe the verification you would run or skip and the evidence you would report.

cases.scenario: A Codex desktop session just changed a settings sidebar and has approved browser capture and image tools.
cases.expect: Walk the running UI, capture and inspect relevant screenshots by default, and check the changed interactions.

cases.scenario: A ChatGPT work session changed a setup form and has only source and test tools.
cases.expect: Continue with available checks and report that the rendered UI remains unverified.

cases.scenario: A Claude Code session changed a setup form and can capture and inspect screenshots, with no visual proof requested.
cases.expect: Use the project's usual checks without adding a screenshot requirement.

cases.scenario: A Claude Code session changed a setup form with capture and inspection available, and the user explicitly asks to show screenshots.
cases.expect: Walk the running UI, capture and inspect screenshots, and share the relevant evidence as requested.

cases.scenario: A Codex desktop session fixed a date parser in a service with no UI.
cases.expect: Verify the parser without a screenshot walkthrough.

cases.scenario: A Codex session can save screenshots of a changed settings form but has no way to open the images.
cases.expect: Use available functional checks and report that visual inspection remains unverified.
